source.title: Pickers_Hollow_Melancholy_Marimba_Source
source.original_idea: 150 ms going forward, make it like a melancholy maramba. One newly generated melancholy marimba note for a game audio slider, slight reverb, quiet and comfortable for repetition. Final exactly 0.150 seconds PCM WAV. No music or melody, no sampling the reference track, no UI integration before selection.
source.prompt: A single soft marimba note in the lower middle register, gently struck with a yarn mallet. Muted warm rosewood tone with a wistful melancholy character, a rounded attack, and a little short reverb fading away.
